title: Partition product embeddings and closed-family retractions
statement: Let $S$ be a nonempty compact metric totally disconnected space in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $A_j$, for $j\in\mathbf N_{>0}$, be nonempty closed subsets of $S$. There exist shrinking refining finite clopen partitions $P_i$ with atom diameter $<(1/2)^i$, continuous maps $\rho_j:S\to A_j$ fixing $A_j$, and an embedding $e:S\to\prod_i P_i$ where each factor has the discrete topology and $e(s)_i$ is the unique atom containing $s$. Each $e(A_j)$ is nonempty and closed in the entire product. No covering assumption on the family is needed.

proof.text: Take the partitions from [lem-sfb-shrinking-clopen-partitions]. Choose the unique atom containing each point at each level. A coordinate of the atom map is constant on each open atom, hence continuous. Points with equal coordinates lie in common atoms with arbitrarily small diameters and therefore have distance zero. Compactness and Hausdorffness make this continuous injection a closed embedding. The continuous image of each nonempty closed A_j is nonempty and closed.

Reindex the coordinates by n+1 to obtain a closed embedding e_N into a natural-number-indexed product of discrete factors. Apply [lem-sfb-countable-discrete-product-closed-retraction] to e_N(A_j), which is nonempty and closed. The restriction A_j to e_N(A_j) is a homeomorphism. Compose e_N, the retraction, and the inverse restricted homeomorphism to obtain rho_j. The fixing identity follows by applying the restricted homeomorphism and using that the product retraction fixes every point of e_N(A_j).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_closedCover_partitions_product
    (S : Type u) [MetricSpace S] [CompactSpace S] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace S]
    [Nonempty S] (A : ℕ+ → Set S) (hclosed : ∀ j, IsClosed (A j))
    (hnonempty : ∀ j, (A j).Nonempty) :
    ∃ P : ℕ+ → Finpartition (Set.univ : Set S),
      (∀ i, P (i + 1) ≤ P i) ∧
      (∀ i p, p ∈ (P i).parts → IsClopen p ∧ Metric.diam p < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ)) ∧
      ∃ ρ : ∀ j, C(S, A j),
        (∀ j (a : A j), ρ j a = a) ∧
        ∃ e : S → ∀ i : ℕ+, WithDiscreteTopology (P i).parts,
          (∀ s i, s ∈ (e s i).ofTopology.val) ∧ IsEmbedding e ∧
          (∀ j, (e '' A j).Nonempty ∧ IsClosed (e '' A j))
